title: P256 compact-grid fused arithmetic with complete cold work

claims.statement: For the protected full-production P-256 target, the complete cold stored-leaf algorithm in proof.md recovers the scalar with probability at least0.39 under the explicitly stated ideal-coin scalar-instruction machine. At q1=377461702,q2=2^28,N=2^70, the total is107196490981610635914782238326461701292032 instructions, below2^126.333525286457 units at C=1000. The former eight-instruction per-leaf bookkeeping reserve is removed because every per-leaf phase is separately charged in the kernel, transport, grouping and scanner rows. All cold generation, capped failures, representation-filter loss, both transport hops and finishing deliveries, grouping, resolution, verification and output are charged. Worst forward/backward/emission bounds are130n+13,645n+11,33n+12; inverse remains conservatively charged39479. The explicit Fourier/Weil bound applies only to the35/96-bit capacity patterns, enabling the proved positive capacity gaps and64-bit address layout. Other fiber bounds are unchanged except their correctly updated bit widths. Exact success exceeds0.3900000017621901. Memory below2^136 bytes, preprocessing below2^118 units included, no auxiliary powers and no nonuniform advice. This is an analytical bound with finite implementation evidence, not a production-size attack or formal certification.

experiments.purpose: Run independent field and pair checks, full batch inversion, metadata and capacity controls, small complete two-hop routing, actual toy scalar recovery, and exact probability/cold-work/layout consequences. Test scope is distinguished from the production proof.
